topic: When can we say AI made a scientific discovery?
style: Fast, cinematic, intriguing and easy to understand
hook: Start immediately with the most surprising or curious aspect of the topic. Do not introduce the channel or waste time.

story_structure.purpose: Explain what the viewer is seeing

visual_direction: Create five visually distinct photorealistic cinematic scenes. Each scene should represent a different part of the story. Use vertical 9:16 composition, realistic lighting, realistic textures and strong visual variety.
narration: Write concise narration suitable for approximately 40 seconds. Use short, natural sentences. Every sentence should add useful information or increase curiosity.
caption_style: Short readable captions. Keep text inside safe screen margins. Never display scene labels such as Scene 1 or Scene 2.
title_strategy: Create a short curiosity-driven YouTube Shorts title without misleading the viewer.
thumbnail_strategy: Use a strong visual moment from the topic. Keep the thumbnail simple and immediately understandable.
rules: No text burned into generated images
Keep the story understandable without sound
